propositions: A new advisory AGENT-tier CONTAINER criterion named decomp-shape must detect two decomposition smell patterns: layer-cake partitioning (children split by architectural layer instead of vertical slices) and consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge (sibling dependency on artifact without explicit ordering edge).

The decomp-shape criterion must be registered in registry.CANONICAL_LLM and registry.AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), added to CONTAINER_CRITERIA in pass1.py, and routed in criteria_routing.json with facet=container, exec=AGENT, default_posture=advisory.

The criterion must be implemented with two sub-answers: has_container_decomposition (gate: parent has >=2 children) and decomposition_shape_sound (finding: fires when layer-cake or ordering-gap detected).
The eval_solver container-arm extension must enable running container criteria via pass1_container when a fixture carries a children: list, supporting bounded sanity testing with <=8 live runs.

Promotion to blocking posture is gated by both E6 order-stability improvement (fleiss_kappa must exceed 0.6 floor) and dogfood effectiveness metrics, documented as a deferred gate in plan-review-gate.md.

All acceptance criteria must pass: registration proof via CLI assertion, unit tests in test_decomp_shape_criterion.py, bounded sanity results in decomp_shape_sanity.json (1.0 recall on positives, 0.0 false-accept on negatives), and criteria-guide validation.
